remarks: Spacious 2BR/1BA apartment occupying the 2nd and 3rd floors of a duplex, ideally located in Springdale, one of Stamford's most convenient and quiet residential neighborhoods.  This freshly painted unit offers a flexible layout with bedrooms on separate levels, ideal for privacy, home office use, or shared living. Large eat-in kitchen with dishwasher, full bathroom with tub, washer/dryer in unit, and separate in-unit storage area.  Parking is a standout feature with a dedicated off-street parking lot plus abundant on-street parking. Peaceful setting while remaining close to shopping, dining, Metro-North, and major commuting routes.

facts.laundryLoc: In unit, laundry room on main floor
